\par\smallskip\raggedright
\textit{Note.} Categories: BEST = a stated ordering puts it first; TIED = no ordering is claimed (or all pass the same criteria); BEHIND = a stated ordering or a failed similarity verdict puts it below; FAILED = does not bound position; PASSED = met its pre-registered criteria with no comparison (Experiment 3, FGO only); N/A = not run. BEHIND, PASSED and N/A are additions to best / tied / failed, used where those three do not fit.\par
\textit{Note.} TIED where no ordering is claimed: standard sensors (the confirmatory test, H1.1; the UKF medians are descriptive), Experiment 2 live (n = 3, descriptive), Experiment 5 (all drift bands PASS; the comparative hypotheses H5.2 / H5.3 / H5.4a--b FAIL on the final-build hold sets, identical to the original-build verdicts) and the closed loop (every set at half real-time (RTF 0.5) passes 3/3). BEHIND: the UKF with heading (C1.a: the FGO is lower on 6/6) and EKF3 in Experiment 4 (H4.2 FAIL; EKF3 the largest in every flight).\par
\textit{Note.} Key numbers: 1A = cruise ATE, median of the 9 textured-floor flights of the standard-sensor dataset; 1B = the 6 textured-floor bags of the two camera datasets; Experiment 2 = horizontal RMSE with 1 tag; Experiment 4 = indoor RMSE; Experiment 3 = with loop closure; Experiment 5 = mean hold error; 1C = at half real-time (RTF 0.5). The simulator ran at half real time; the commanded flight speed was unchanged at 0.5 m/s. \textdagger{} runaway magnitude (order only). No cell restates a WITHDRAWN claim.\par
